## Verified resolution — original UI-022 scope

The source fix and evidence are committed and pushed at `70114ff3d579af291c4a3028181efc7d884e23a9`. Every original acceptance criterion in this issue has been reviewed; original body/title/labels/history remain unchanged.

### Actual immutable verification
[Run40540209480](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40540209480) at `ea79ab8cf30132b4b37985f175d00287382ddca8` executes **123/123 native-simulator methods in25 fresh XML**, zero failures/errors/skips. All16 mandatory genuine UIKit methods/six sources,725 own Git inputs, exact commands/runtime and Worker/runner/console/owned cleanup are independently reviewed. Owning current source files match the tested revision.

- `emptyTabsClearSelectionAndRepopulationClampsIndex`: actual native items populate, clear and repopulate; selection resets/clamps at positive and negative bounds; production delegate callbacks deliver current indexes only.
- `selectionUsesCurrentNativeMembershipInsteadOfStaleOrMutableTags`: reordering/late or foreign callbacks, mutable `Long` tags and replaced delegate owners cannot resurrect obsolete selection.

The callbacks invoke the actual production `UITabBarDelegate` with real native objects; they are **not physical touch injection**, orientation/trait/accessibility or all-device certification. Programmatic setup/clear does not fabricate callbacks.
